entry.note: Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.2140/gt.2006.10.1239) and arXiv e-print LaTeX source math/0406242v4.

relevance.rationale: Primary source for canonical geometric layered ideal triangulations of punctured-torus bundles (RL monodromy words) and, via Futer's Appendix B, of hyperbolic two-bridge link complements (4_1 from R, 5_2 from RL).

keyResults.locator: Thm. 1.1 & Prop. prop:concavity (§2-8); Appendix B by D. Futer (§9-10)
keyResults.statement: Proves Rivin angle-polytope concavity and geometricity of layered ideal triangulations from RL words on punctured-torus bundles and Farey words on hyperbolic two-bridge links.
